title: Two equal accounts that a HashSet counts twice
prompt: AccountKey overrides equals and not hashCode, so two equal keys land in different buckets and a HashMap loses the entry. Fix it, using the standard library rather than hand-written arithmetic, and keep equals consistent with hashCode.
check: codeonly AccountKey.java | grep -q 'public int hashCode' && codeonly AccountKey.java | grep -q 'Objects.hash' && codeonly AccountKey.java | grep -q 'public boolean equals' && codeonly AccountKey.java | grep -q '@Override'
